verdict.rationale: A community commenter credits a talk on building custom renderers through React's exposed interfaces, describing React as a declarative API for nearly any platform. First-party evidence shows the component model already targets non-DOM platforms (React Native for iOS/Android, server rendering), but none of it documents an interface for writing your own renderer. missing for 10: first-party documentation of a custom renderer/reconciler API, a guide or reference for implementing host configs, hands-on corroboration of building a custom renderer.
